lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: It's not stopping.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: What's not?

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: The implant under my collarbone. It was quiet at Velorum. Since the boarding party it won't settle, like something keeps reaching for it.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: That came from the hold. Stay here.

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.text: Oh gods. Oh gods, Kessler, she's...

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Don't touch me.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: No one's hurting you. We found you. You're safe now.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: They said people would come. They said that's how you know it's the extraction.

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.text: We're not extraction. We're salvage. And we're getting you out.

lines.speaker: Dominion Enforcer 1
lines.text: Boarding initiated. All station personnel, standby for manifest verification.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Iris. The lock. Now.

lines.speaker: Dominion Enforcer 2
lines.text: Man down! Contact in Bay Seven! Non-compliance!

lines.speaker: Dominion Enforcer 3
lines.text: Requesting backup! Requesting immediate backup!

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Clear. You're clear. Get back to the ship.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: You have the same eyes. Did they take yours too?

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: I don't remember.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: My name is Mira. They were going to take me for augmentation extraction. That's what the Overseer said. That's what I ran from.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: I'm taking you somewhere safe.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: What's your name?

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: I don't have one.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: You can't keep her. The moment we move off-station with a child in the hold, we become everything the Dominion hunts.

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.text: I'm not leaving her.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: Then we don't move off-station.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Undock in ten seconds or the soldiers board the bridge. We have exactly one move.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Gods. They already know.

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.text: Know what?

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: A child with partial Dominion augmentation is a library to them. Memories to strip. Neural patterns to replicate. She's not cargo to them, she's a research specimen.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: And they know she's here.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: They're launching from the fringe. Corvette class. They want her alive.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: Then we don't stop.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: They've got lock! Evasive!

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: I've got the cannon. Banking left.

lines.speaker: Hollow Kings Pilot
lines.text: Target is evading. Sustained pursuit authorized.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Corvette is repositioning. You've got maybe sixty seconds.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: Twenty-eight seconds remaining.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Nice work. Come home.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: They told me I'd never see outside. That the only view that mattered was the target reticle.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: I know that language.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: We're going to the Fringe colonies. You'll be safe there.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Sit. Let me look at it.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: I've seen this mark before. On other operatives. Never on one still walking around to ask about it.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: It's not a kill-switch waiting to be thrown. It's one that was already thrown.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: On Kethel-7, whatever you did there, they tried to put you down. This fired. It should have stopped your heart. Instead it burned out your memory and left you breathing.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: Then why am I alive?

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: I don't know. Somebody built this wrong, or built it to fail. You didn't survive the Dominion. You survived your own execution.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: They built you to end crime syndicates, not to collect children.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: Then whatever they made me for, it's done. The rest is mine.

lines.speaker: Dominion Hunter
lines.text: Stand down. This is a retrieval authorization.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: She was never going to the Ronin Program.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: The Dominion doesn't care which syndicate holds the children. They feed them all and look the other way.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: She was collateral to that arrangement.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: It's a lure. False distress. But the records it's broadcasting are real.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: They're from Block Seven. Senna. Lyric. Keph. The others. They're all on that list.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: We turn away from this. We sail dark and hope no one's tracking us.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: I won't leave them.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: If you care about the girl, you care about the rest of them.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Left corridor. The second door on your right is clear. The chamber after has three of them. Can you see the air vents?

lines.speaker: Crimson Lotus Enforcer 1
lines.text: Intruder in medical! Blade response!

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Rescue pod bay ahead. Third corridor, door marked 7-C. That's where they are.

lines.speaker: Senna
lines.text: Are you Dominion?

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Senna
lines.text: Then you're one of us. Some things come back, when you're ready, they come back.

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: You are my finest instrument. Return the children and submit to retrieval. I will make you useful again, and you will not remember refusing.

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: Refuse, and I stop hunting the weapon and start hunting the man who hides it. How long does your salvager last?

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: He's in your head. Don't listen.

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: Five minutes, Seven. Then I choose for you.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: Let me go back.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: I said no. We've come too far for you to give yourself back to them.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Come home. Now.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: You came back for us.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: If they told you we don't matter, they lied.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: Resistance Doctor
lines.text: The switch in you is dead as a trigger, it already fired. But it's still wired to their network; they can try to throw it again from anywhere.

lines.speaker: Resistance Doctor
lines.text: I can't cut it out, I don't have the tools. But I can jam its carrier signal. Stay inside the field and they can't reach it. Step outside, and you're exposed.

lines.speaker: Resistance Doctor
lines.text: There's a small school here. A garden. People who won't ask where you came from. The children can stay.

lines.speaker: Rustfang Raider
lines.text: Dominion contract says this sanctuary burns! Move in!

lines.speaker: Rustfang Raider
lines.text: Hold the platform! The bounty's worth the blood!

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: What will you do now?

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: I don't know.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: That used to sound like failure.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Doesn't it now?

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: No. Not anymore.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: I found it in the station's secondary vault. I think it's about you.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: I can try to decode it. I learned enough about neural security before I ran. If you want me to.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: Try.

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.text: You're thinking about the file.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: I am.

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.text: If they wiped you to make you useful, is who you were before still in there to find? Some part they couldn't burn out?

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: I don't know.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Doctor's jammer is holding. As long as we stay in the field, they can't reach the switch. We're safe, for now.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Mira's still working that encrypted file. Kethel-7. If anything's left of who you were, it's in there.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: Then we find out who I was, and why they couldn't kill me.
